evidence.detail: next_season_num() returns the season's sequential number (not the DB id/PK)
season_id = seasons.next_season_num() — stores a season *number* in a variable called season_id, illustrating the confusion
SQL schema uses season_id as FK referencing season.id, but season.number is the human-visible season number — the two concepts collide in variable names throughout the codebase
next_season_num is called in 20+ places and its result is frequently assigned to variables named season_id, propagating the ambiguity

triage.notes: The issue body itself says 'This may not be resolvable' — the DB schema uses season.id as PK and season.number for the sequential number, but large portions of the codebase blur the two. A full rename would touch 20+ files. Scope is well beyond 150 lines.
